ac:layout-cell.h1: E-Invoice Onboarding API Reuse and Spain Changes
ac:layout-cell.p: Products: Sage 50, Sage 200, Sage Active and Sage X3 are the ERPs; Despachos serves accountants. Each product needs the SXS and Tax/Connections integrations in 038. Resolve the client's dataset and reuse required credentials before onboarding; an unavailable lookup stays pending.
039 owns the sequences, product impact and GAP decisions. This page shows request/response examples and Spain changes.

Phase coverage: 1 — SPFE public solution; 2 — external private providers; 3 — Sage private-platform offering. Labels show analysis coverage, not delivery approval or confirmed API availability. REF-PHASE.
039 §2 — Open engineering decisions is the authoritative GAP-01–08 register. See GAP-02 — Spain connection model and GAP-06 — Certificate reuse and ID relationships before applying the examples.

Grey: existing calls/fields. · Blue: proposed Spain values or additional work. · Red: open questions, uncertainty or assumptions requiring validation. Examples use synthetic data and documented sandbox URLs. Replace IDs with service-returned values. Responses are extracts. Blue values, including es.nif, require API-owner confirmation; they do not prove provider availability or introduce new keys.

Existing contract: calls use dataset, access-point and connection IDs; addresses belong to a connection. The supplied guide describes one connection per dataset/access-point pair. This does not select how Spain maps platforms to those resources. FR-02/03/05; INT-AP01/06.

tr.td: Another supported platform, with no saved setup
If it maps to a separate access point, API-01/02 find the service and API-03 POST creates its dataset connection. Other mappings need GAP-02 assessment.
2–3; SPFE use TBD

API-05 PUT, action: "add", using that connection's existing IDs.

ac:layout-cell.p: All five E-Invoice templates use required Bearer M2M authentication and optional traceparent/tracestate. POST/PUT bodies use application/vnd.api+json; API-03 also requires Idempotency-Key. FR-01–05.
ac:layout-cell.h3: 1.1 API-01 — Discover services — Phases 2–3; SPFE use TBD
ac:layout-cell.p: FR-01 · 039 private setup.

p.strong: Request — no body or path parameters:

ac:layout-cell.p: Portfolio candidates: B2B Router, Banqup (Unifiedpost), EDICOM, SERES (Docaposte) and ZeroComa. New candidate: Sovos. REF-PROVIDERS. Confirm target Spain services, contracts and IDs/environments before offering them; this catalogue entry is illustrative. GAP-02/06/08.

ac:layout-cell.h3: 1.2 API-02 — Find existing connections — Phases 2–3; SPFE use TBD
ac:layout-cell.p: FR-02 · 039 private setup.

p.span: BA working hypothesis: one company dataset can connect to B2B Router and Banqup, with a separate access point and E-Invoice connection ID for each platform. This is an unvalidated BA proposal, not an observed Spain API result or an agreed design. Architecture and Engineering must validate or replace it under GAP-02.

p.strong: Illustrative response using the existing 200 OK structure — BA hypothesis, not a validated Spain response:

ac:layout-cell.p: Keep each returned connectionId. A disconnected entry has DISCONNECTED and connectionId: null. Under this hypothesis, API-03 creates a missing dataset/access-point connection; the actual Spain call depends on GAP-02. More saved connections do not activate routing or enable Private A to Private B switching. REF-CONNECTIONS.

p.span: Confirm Spain dataset mapping and concurrent provider support. Public entries depend on the GAP-02 decision. The existing array is a reuse candidate, not proof that the selected Spain model needs no contract change. GAP-01/02/06.

ac:layout-cell.h3: 1.3 API-03 — Connect — Phases 2–3; SPFE use TBD
ac:layout-cell.p: FR-03 · 039 private setup.

tr.td: Register initial addresses
One or more entries in accessPointAddresses[] for the selected connection.
Use supported address formats
Current, legal, or both formats in one request, as shown in the supplied France examples.
Set address dates
Optional effectiveDate and endDate per address.
Set address usage
Optional usage, at most one explicit value; omitted/null permits all supported operations.
Supply company/requester details
Existing company fields and user audit context.

ac:layout-cell.p: POST creates one dataset/access-point connection with these initial addresses. Add addresses later through API-05 PUT. Under 038 ONB-05, confirm the chosen provider account first; API-03 does not prove provider account onboarding. Reuse a valid Sage connection without another POST.

p.strong: Request — Sage 200 creates missing Sage setup for its customer's existing B2B Router account:

ac:structured-macro.ac:plain-text-body:
POST https://api-sbx.e-invoicing.sage.com/connectors/{accessPointId}/datasets/{datasetId}/connect
Authorization: Bearer {sageIdM2MToken}
Idempotency-Key: {idempotencyKey}
traceparent: {traceparent}
tracestate: {tracestate}
Content-Type: application/vnd.api+json

{
  "data": {
    "type": "AccessPointConnection",
    "attributes": {
      "companyName": "Example Spain SL",
      "companyAddress": "Calle de Ejemplo 1",
      "companyPostalCode": "28000",
      "companyCountryCode": "ES",
      "user": {
        "firstName": "Casey",
        "lastName": "Example",
        "jobTitle": null,
        "emailAddress": "user@example.invalid",
        "clientIPAddress": "192.0.2.10"
      },
      "accessPointAddresses": [
        {
          "accessPointAddressType": "es.nif",
          "accessPointAddress": "NIF_TBD",
          "usage": null
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}

ac:layout-cell.p: Save data.id as connectionId; setup is still in progress. Certificates use the separate calls in §2.

p.span: Confirm ES/es.nif values, NIF/NIE formats, multi-address grouping, date/usage rules, provider binding and safe replay. France current/legal formats do not define Spain address formats. GAP-02/04/06.

ac:layout-cell.h3: 1.4 API-04 — Read connection progress — Phases 2–3; SPFE use TBD
ac:layout-cell.p: FR-04 · 039 recovery.
Read the original connection after uncertainty. An address in RETRYING stays under observation; do not reconnect it. An empty/failed read does not prove no earlier effect. INT-AP05/06; GAP-04.

p.span: Confirm status/error mappings. CONNECTED alone does not prove certificate suitability, public access or route activation. GAP-05/06.

ac:layout-cell.h3: 1.5 API-05 — Update supported setup — Phases 2–3; SPFE use TBD
ac:layout-cell.p: FR-05 · 039 supported change.

tr.td: Add an address
accessPointAddresses[].action: "add" under the existing connection.
Change an existing address's dates
action: "update"; only effectiveDate and/or endDate.
Add and update together
Both actions in one array; see source example mixed-actions-success.
Restrict operations on a new address
Optional usage applies only to add; omitted/null permits all supported operations.
Edit company/requester details
Existing company name/address/postcode/country and user fields in UpdateAccessPointConnectionRequest.

ac:layout-cell.p: The current contract groups addresses by base SIREN. Confirm Spain grouping and provider effects; no SIREN hierarchy is assumed for NIF. GAP-02/06/07/08.

p.strong: Request — add an address to this connection:

ac:structured-macro.ac:plain-text-body:
PUT https://api-sbx.e-invoicing.sage.com/connectors/{accessPointId}/datasets/{datasetId}/connections/{connectionId}/
Authorization: Bearer {sageIdM2MToken}
traceparent: {traceparent}
tracestate: {tracestate}
Content-Type: application/vnd.api+json

{
  "data": {
    "type": "AccessPointConnection",
    "attributes": {
      "accessPointAddresses": [
        {
          "action": "add",
          "accessPointAddressType": "es.nif",
          "accessPointAddress": "NIF_TBD",
          "effectiveDate": "2026/11/01"
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}

ac:layout-cell.p: For this existing-connection example, keep connectionId; use API-04 for the address result. Routing changes require separate authorisation and a confirmed Routing interface in 039.
ac:layout-cell.h2: 2 Certificate management — proposed call to confirm — Phases 1–3, where required
ac:layout-cell.p: INT-CERT01–03 document existing ES AFL credential handling. Qualify B2B reuse, dataset binding and secure provisioning before activation. GAP-03/06; SPEC001 G1/G3/G9/G10/G11. No certificate field is added to API-03.

tr.td: E-Invoice API-03 data.id; API-02 connectionId
Identifies an AccessPointConnection. Used by API-04/05. FR-02/03.
Tax certificate upload data.id; ES AFL Connection-Id
Identifies a Connection used to select stored credentials. INT-CERT01–03.

ac:layout-cell.p: ID relationship unconfirmed: the sources do not establish whether these IDs are shared, mapped or independent. Until the Tax/Connections and E-Invoice API owners confirm the contract, retain each reference with its source and do not substitute one for the other. See 039 GAP-06. Different synthetic IDs in these examples do not prove separate ID namespaces.
ac:layout-cell.h3: 2.1 Existing certificate provisioning — Phases 1–3, where required
ac:layout-cell.p: The AEAT guide supplies both calls below. Internal Sandbox uses https://api-int.network-eng.sage.com; production uses https://api.network.sage.com. Enablement supplies each product/environment's API key. Both calls require Bearer Domain Services authentication, x-api-key, traceparent and Idempotency-Key; tracestate is optional. Request media type is not specified. INT-CERT03.

p.strong: Find the provider — skip if its correct environment-specific ID is already known. No body:

ac:layout-cell.p: Select providerCode: "es-aeat" and keep its data[].id as providerId. This catalogue does not list saved customer credentials. The documented category is es-aeat-afl; confirm whether B2B can use this provider. Do not invent a B2B provider ID.

p.strong: Upload only a confirmed missing required credential — request:

ac:layout-cell.p: Keep data.id as the credential reference. 201 confirms provisioning, not validated certificate readiness. expiresBy is optional declared expiry. The response also supplies data.links.credentialsPatchEndpoint.href; it does not define an update method/body. INT-CERT03.

Source conflict: the example uses credentials.credentialsObject; the field table uses certificate.credentialsObject. Tax/Connections must confirm nesting. Confirm the B2B secure-provisioning path; the AFL certificate/password example does not establish that boundary. SPEC001 G3/G11.
ac:layout-cell.h3: 2.2 Existing internal encryption — Phases 1–3, if AFL reuse is qualified
ac:layout-cell.p: Connections Service invokes AFL encryption internally. This is not an additional ERP call. The source extract owns its payload; secret serialisation remains unconfirmed. INT-CERT01/02.
ac:layout-cell.h3: 2.3 Credential selection and the additional onboarding result — Phases 1–3, where required
ac:layout-cell.p: ES AFL selects customer certificates or the Sage seal with Connection-Id: <credential-connection-id>. INT-CERT02. Confirm product-supplied versus backend-resolved selection for B2B; this is not a confirmed E-Invoice API header.

tr.td: Suitable certificate already held
Reuse its reference after confirming client/environment/action mapping. Failed lookup stays pending; it does not justify another upload.
Add another platform that requires a certificate

Apply the Spain-confirmed rule in 038: reuse the same suitable certificate and complete separate platform onboarding (configuration and setup). Per-action acceptance, credential-ID relationships and implementation support for reuse remain unvalidated under GAP-06; E-Invoice resource mapping remains GAP-02.
Missing or unsuitable certificate
Provision missing material or correct expired/revoked/unsuitable material through the qualified flow.
Sage seal
Confirm dedicated provider/type, B2B permission and stored purpose-specific agreement. Customers do not upload Sage's seal.

ac:layout-cell.p: The trusted-service retrieval contract documents GET/200 for HMRC access tokens. Its response exposes credentials; it is not an ERP onboarding call. AEAT certificate shape, B2B permission and safe reference/readiness lookup remain unconfirmed. INT-CERT04.

Readiness must identify the selected reference/material version, validated expiry, trust/revocation, action suitability and next action/owner. No certificate-readiness response schema is supplied. SPEC001 CERT-04/05 proposes NOT_REQUIRED, READY, EXPIRING, ACTION_REQUIRED, BLOCKED, UNDETERMINED; these are not Tax wire values. NIF validity and business permission remain separate. Public WSDLs use certificate-authenticated HTTPS, not a certificate business-field. SPFE-S03/S16.
